## Summary

Describe the change and the user problem it addresses.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests pass locally or in CI.
- [ ] New protocol behavior has positive and negative vectors.
- [ ] Package/build behavior is validated where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation and schemas are updated.

## Compatibility

- [ ] Existing v0.1 artifacts and verifiers remain unchanged.
- [ ] New artifact fields and protocol identifiers are explicitly versioned.
- [ ] Unknown or malformed inputs fail closed.

## Security, privacy, and rights

- [ ] No secrets, confidential source information, or sensitive personal data are included.
- [ ] Threat model and abuse cases have been considered.
- [ ] Cryptographic claims are limited to what the implementation proves.
- [ ] Network access, permissions, dependencies, and side effects are documented.

## Maturity

- [ ] The change is labeled accurately as proposal, experimental, or production-ready.
- [ ] Independent review requirements are identified.
